notes.title: Update #7: Seasons - The Dessert Kingdom
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
 
Are you ready to start the sweet adventure? 🍰😁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/78541f3a38b1fd20994a0c6c1b1d8c16938f3c15.jpg[/img]

Tap on the Campaign button in the main menu and set off on a journey in the sweet Kingdoms together with your loyal friends Comic, Clumsy, Naughty, and Loafer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/007ad4e8fb5d760366ed629d543767fc62894326.jpg[/img]
 
Start off with the Tutorial and learn how to quickly get to the yummy cake that we hid on the gameboard. Find out how to use the boosters: Caramel bombs, Radar, and Caramel Attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/e94770366f866bd42abbca4daa641890e4bb714b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/21a7c1d4f81084dbb06b612e3a6f56b233678607.gif[/img]
 
Complete three tutorial fields and move on to the next level. Our pastry chef baked a lot of yummy fields of various shapes for you to open and taste their different fillings, one by one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/96a89a969e8d24cf4bcde5c2a8e135fd9bd7b33b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/a4ee7ce83de5d618d6c1bc42a2d21431030af985.gif[/img]
 
Choose the difficulty of the King you play against before each match. The King doesn’t use boosters on the Easy level. On Medium and Hard difficulty levels you will see the King’s available boosters. Remember, the harder it gets, the sweeter your reward will be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f1699ebf1357783493bf680fe03f5378c1ddd916.jpg[/img]
 
You can select three different boosters for each match, and if you lose, you can always replay it!
 
Track your progress in the Kingdom in the Main Menu: it shows all levels you completed, along with their difficulty levels. You can choose and replay any level you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/76ca4dee54b0d0e7f7e7ec13e7c52f012fa8973a.jpg[/img]
 
Complete a Kingdom to unlock the next one. 
 
Earn stars for each victory and uncover another surprise soon. You'll learn more about it in upcoming updates.

You have to spend some Donuts from your storage to start a level. But don't worry, we'll restore one Donut per minute and a half for you!
 
Let's go, friends! To the new sweet victories and achievements! 😉🏆

notes.title: Update #6: New Boosters
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
There are two new boosters in the Jolly Kingdom: vertical and horizontal caramel bombs! They will make the yummy battles even juicier and more fascinating. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/c3ba942ef319b93ffed93fc8e73042b2bda5eeab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f98411d24da207a6919c169b87d43a1d376dbb70.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/7f1d46fb1717ac32d5d5eae9b0b3feb10f9fc76f.gif[/img]

Select 3 types of boosters from your tasty store ahead of every battle. While choosing them you’ll see the total number of every booster you have and how many of each type you can bring with you into a game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/ea71644cfc9b7ff572ea349671dec3e4e234b67f.gif[/img]

What’s new in this update: 
[list]
[*] new caramel bombs;
[*] improved UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #5: Daily Quests
notes.notes:
Hi there!

A new challenge is now available to all of you sweet tooths in the Jolly Kingdom! Enter the game and find two new daily quests. Complete them and grab the rewards! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/b1fad4f7be792119cb6ca26d93da0c43af0a0982.jpg[/img]

Don't forget to claim a final reward for completing both of them!

notes.title: Update #4: Caramel attack
notes.notes:
The Jolly Battle got everybody carried away. No one in the Jolly Kingdom has noticed that the scent of caramel attracted a new guest. To the sounding laughter of the cheerful company, the Bumblebee joined the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/e19ae980202fe7e92059d15ebc681384f7963fb6.png[/img]

He quickly got used to it: picked up lollipops with his fuzzy belly, soared in the air and dropped caramel bombs at once. Then he disappeared again to eat honey and to get ready for a new adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/d52725ac2f96af0dbf313c71cd5742f0e81344aa.gif[/img]

Try Bumblebee in action: activate him in the right direction on the game board after every 5 moves.

notes.title: Update #3: Radar
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Meet a new dweller of the Jolly Kingdom - Flappy! 

Once upon a time, there were naughty cakes that got carried away and played until dark. It was hard to hit each other with candy in the twilight and they were very upset. They wanted the game to go on! But suddenly a firefly started flapping his wings over their heads.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f7fff9aae50b952db6ad4e59f81127139df975dd.png[/img]

He whelmed the sweet characters with glittering sweets, highlighting one after another. And the fun continued! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/c5225e49b1ea3cd18ed780bcce47c2654924f71c.gif[/img]

Dwellers were happy to welcome Flappy into their kingdom. After all, the more characters take part in Jolly Battles, the more exciting the game is! 😁 And now it is your turn to call Flappy to rescue 😉

What’s new in this update: 
[list]
[*] introduced a radar to detect the opponent’s cakes;
[*] replaced the First Game on Lan achievement with the First Game with a Friend (co-op game with a pin code access);
[*] minor bugfix. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update #2: Caramel Bombs
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
The long-awaited update has finally arrived at the Jolly Kingdom!
Here, check this out:
[list]
[*] A new weapon for you to join the battle for the Royal Cake: caramel bombs! Earn coins and use them to buy bombs at the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/4983c199b278240d16c583e219622fc4fe772095.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/0330bd16f1766f505bca15b4314b68cbd1fff358.gif[/img]

[*] Daily rewards. Get in the game every day and receive packs of coins and free bombs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/23a07a3f851b00b66612a6a97d36d552be9c2909.jpg[/img]

[*] Improved multiplayer. Now you can use a pin code to play with a friend. It's easy: start a new game and send your friend a code: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f70bda3595158a5b5a65f9272785a8804712165e.jpg[/img]

He has only to push “Join” and enter the code:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/8361a86e34c25f6e3593056e884714c201f89f2f.jpg[/img]

You can even cross-play with mobile devices. 
[/list]

May the Jolly Battle begin! 🍰 🍭 😁 😺 

Jolly Battle cakes can't wait for your feedback!

notes.title: Jolly Battle – Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi, guys and gals!


We hope you had fun this summer 😍 🍓🍒. We, for our part, analyzed your feedback 👀 and prepared a few nice surprises for you 😺! We are happy to announce the upcoming first update of Jolly Battle! 😀


Here is what we added to the game:	

[list]   [*]42 achievements
   [*]Character emotions for a miss, a hit, and a tap 😅 😨 😉

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/d42d233b120948f5f222ed37e063a3180533a4eb.gif[/img]
